name: H P Electronics
old_description: Joe has been working professionally with audio, video and related systems since 1988. Starting as a guitar accessory salesman at a large Musical Instrument Retailer, Joe advanced to become the Department Head of the Drum Section and then the Pro Sound Division. This experience led him in 1998 to HP Electronics, Inc. and the installation side of Audio and Video, where he has learned the sophisticated needs and techniques of designing and implementing professional, commercial grade AV. As a working musician, sound person and project studio owner, Joe understands the aspects of theater and house of worship presentations beyond his design and installation work at HP, offering additional guidance to his clients. Outside of work and music, Joe enjoys sports, especially baseball and hockey, the outdoors and spending time with his wife and 2 kids.
about:
HP Electronics, Inc. was established in 1983 in Baltimore, Maryland, as a licensed electrical contractor specializing in low-voltage electronic systems, distribution sub-systems, and fiber-optic transport media. The company has grown into a provider of professional sound, video, communication, and integrated control systems.

The firm designs and installs audio systems, area-of-rescue emergency communication, classroom AV, synchronized clock and timekeeping networks, control system integration, digital signage, and campus-wide intercom and paging. Its project portfolio spans nationwide and overseas; the company notes that it designed and installed one of the first modern sound systems on mainland China. Over 75 percent of new business comes from client referrals.

HP Electronics serves education, healthcare, corporate and commercial, government and public sector, houses of worship, entertainment venues, retail, and hospitality. Recent projects include the New Severn Run High School auditorium and stadium, and the Church of the Resurrection.

The company states its founding philosophy centers on making client satisfaction the most important product it delivers, aiming to be the most sought-after electronic systems contractor through a pledge of high-level design, installation, and service that earns referrals.
